name: popsicle
headline: motia-ContentCreation-Agent: Social Media
short_description: Social Media Automation workflow using Motia.  A streamlined content generation agent built with [Motia](https://github.com/MotiaDev/motia) that transforms articles into engaging Twitter threads and LinkedIn posts using AI.
author: Krish01agrawal

sections.overview:
This skill automates social media content creation by converting articles into platform-specific posts. It works through a four-step workflow: receiving an article URL, scraping content via Firecrawl, generating Twitter and LinkedIn-optimized content using Deepseek-R1 locally, and scheduling drafts in Typefully for review. Built with Motia as the unified backend framework, it eliminates manual content adaptation across platforms. Content marketers, social media managers, and content creators benefit from reduced production time and consistent multi-platform publishing.
Convert blog articles into Twitter threads for broader reach
Generate LinkedIn posts from existing web content
Batch create social content drafts for multi-platform scheduling
Automate content repurposing from industry news and articles
sections.setup:
No install command available. Check the GitHub repository for manual installation instructions.
`git clone https://github.com/Krish01agrawal/motia-ContentCreation-Agent`
sections.usage:
```
Create a social media automation workflow using Motia to transform the following article into engaging Twitter threads and LinkedIn posts. Article: [ARTICLE_TEXT]. Target audience: [TARGET_AUDIENCE]. Key themes to highlight: [KEY_THEMES].
```
Copy

```
# Social Media Automation Workflow for [COMPANY] in [INDUSTRY]
```
requirements: Claude Code or compatible AI agent
